description: User uploads an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file; columns are fuzzy-mapped to an existing EBS report template using dcAutoMap()
example_use_case: Upload a vendors.xlsx file — columns 'Vendor Name', 'Status' auto-mapped to VENDOR_NAME, VENDOR_STATUS in suppliers_report

description: User enters a SQL-like query; the app simulates query execution against in-memory test data without a real DB connection
example_use_case: Run 'SELECT employee_number full_name department FROM employees WHERE status=ACTIVE' to get simulated employee data mapped to active_employees report

description: User enters a real Oracle EBS connection (host, port, SID, user, password) and SQL; requires a backend proxy server to relay JDBC calls — not available in standalone HTML mode
example_use_case: Connect to production EBS DB and run AP invoice SQL to load real data into aged_payables_detail report
